items: Added: Desk Buddy now checks for new versions by itself and installs them when you click Install (About › Updates)
Bigger Kindle screens work (Paperwhite 3, 4, 5, Signature Edition, Oasis), from 1.1
Version numbers now match the GitHub release (0.9 → 1.2)
Changed: the task list works like Notion: nothing moves when you hover, click a task to edit it, drag the handle on its left to move it
Added: when Desk Buddy on your Mac was reinstalled, the PC says so and offers Join again
Added: real app icons on the Kindle's Deck
Fixed: the Deck lists all your apps, including ones from the Microsoft Store (WhatsApp, Calculator…)
Fixed: favourites on the Deck open again, and start out as apps you actually have
Added: music from this PC on the Kindle: Spotify, Apple Music, browsers and more, with album covers and play / pause / skip
Added: change the PC's volume and sound output from the Kindle
Added: your calendars on the Kindle: add your Google or Outlook calendar link in This PC › Calendar
Fixed: Windows Defender could flag Desk Buddy as a threat. It no longer uses PowerShell to eject the Kindle
Added: a green "Kindle connected" badge on Home
Fixed: putting Desk Buddy on a Kindle that had it before keeps its cover in the library
Added: put Desk Buddy on a Kindle from here: plug it in with USB and click once (Kindle page). It's set up to connect by itself. Or save the files and copy them yourself
Added: About › Updates: check for updates, see what's new before you install, and look back at what came in each version
Added: Desk Buddy updates itself (Update Desk Buddy at the bottom of the sidebar)
Changed: the window matches the Mac app: the same pages and icons, and a sidebar you can fold
Added: drag and drop in the task list
Added: Desk Buddy can run on this PC (Server › This PC)
Added: the Desk Buddy window: your tasks, every Kindle setting, this PC and the server
First version: connects this PC to the Kindle from the tray (in use, light or dark, the Deck)
